item.description: By SYLVIE CORBET and JOHN LEICESTER PARIS (AP) — The home of the “Mona Lisa” is getting a new boss. Art historian Christophe Leribault, a veteran museum director, is taking over at the Louvre, shouldering the challenge of getting the world’s largest museum out of crisis after the brazen heist in October of the French crown jewels. item.title: Jackson County Firefighters practice grain bin rescues
item.description: JACKSON COUNTY, Miss. (WXXV)- Jackson County firefighters are learning this week how to perform grain bin rescues. Firefighters are learning the proper techniques to rescue people in the event of a grain bin collapse. The training is being hosted by the Farm Bureau Office in Lucedale.
